title: Ahab's Legacy and Jehoshaphat's Reign
description: After a brief summary of Ahab's deeds, his son Ahaziah becomes king over Israel. Then the chapter tells about Jehoshaphat's reign in Judah: he walked in the ways of his father Asa and did what was right in the Lord's eyes, but the high places were not removed. He made peace with the king of Israel, removed the male temple prostitutes, and built ships at Tarshish to bring gold from Ophir, but the ships were wrecked at Ezion-Geber. Jehoshaphat refused Ahaziah's request for a joint voyage. After Jehoshaphat's death, his son Joram became king in Judah, while Ahaziah ruled wickedly in Israel and worshiped Baal.
